ctx.x: They made their money, the racketeers, running whiskey across the Hudson River or some bay up there which connected the United States with Canada. And when the Coast Guard would overtake them, they would have these cans, not in cases, but in a big old thing like a net. And they just would throw it overboard, and the whiskey wouldn't sink. And later on, while the Coast Guard was chasing that boat, this other boat comes behind it to pick up the whiskey. Because they wouldn't worry about the whiskey so much as to…
